reviewedTree.hashAlgorithm: sha256(concat(sorted relativePath + NUL + sha256(original bytes) + LF))

methodology: Fetched the current public GitHub Advisory Database HEAD and compared the complete pinned-to-current repository trees. All 115 changed paths are unreviewed.

Read and JSON-parsed all 36,899 Reviewed files from the clean current checkout and reproduced the previously committed full-content hash. Identical Git tree IDs independently confirm no Reviewed addition, deletion or byte change.

No changed Reviewed records require a new maintainer review. Existing verification timestamps, fixed snapshot, source URLs, curated records, aliases, CVSS provenance and withdrawal history remain unchanged.
Successful unchanged checking is recorded here separately from failures and from changes to source publication/modification timestamps.
limitations: This confirms the Reviewed corpus did not change through the observed HEAD, not that all maintainer advisories or all public vulnerabilities were independently rechecked.
The 115 unreviewed changes remain outside the Reviewed ingestion contract; supplemental source matching is reported separately.
No independent exploitation or KEV verification follows from an unchanged Reviewed tree.
